title: Ensure pre-commit hook runs generate:types after payload.config.ts changes
body: The stale payload-types.ts was not caught before commit. Consider adding a pre-commit hook that runs 'git diff payload.config.ts && pnpm generate:types' to ensure types are always regenerated when the config changes.
rationale: If a pre-commit hook validated payload.config.ts changes and auto-regenerated types, this CI failure would have been caught locally.

title: Consolidate node: protocol handling into a single authoritative place
body: The node: protocol handling has been attempted via resolve.scheme webpack plugin (removed in 2475), resolve.alias (added then removed in 2476), and now both externals + comprehensive resolve.alias. Document in a comment in next.config.js that the correct pattern is BOTH externals for the package AND resolve.alias for individual node: protocol stubs, so future maintainers don't remove one thinking the other is sufficient.
rationale: Three CI failures (2475, 2476, and this session) were caused by incomplete node: protocol fixes that only addressed one layer of the problem. The correct approach needs both externals (prevents analysis) and resolve.alias (stubs any references webpack does analyze).
